wildcard_pool.display: The Library Is Not the Institute

flagged_contenders.rule: Candidates with one or more flags whose best scenario rank is within the threshold.

frontier_disagreement.rule: Every unique scenario leader, ordered by the same model-disagreement rule.

model_disagreement.rule: Largest per-axis profile-score range, then mean axis range, display, and candidate ID.

pareto_pool.rule: Union of candidates marked Pareto in any scenario, retaining every membership.

resurrection_pool.rule: Candidates outside every scenario leader pool that rank in the top K by at least one axis mean.

scenario_deliberation.rule: Start with scenario leaders, then replace the lowest-ranked non-wildcards with the next ranked wildcards until the floor is met.

scenario_leaders.rule: Diagnostic top candidates in each scenario by score, then display and candidate ID; not a deliberative narrowing pool.

wildcard_pool.rule: Every candidate with wildcard=true, ordered by best scenario rank then display.
